title: Strong coupling dynamics of defect RG flows in ABJM
summary: Wilson loop operators in ABJM theory provide a rich arena for studying defect conformal field theories (dCFTs) and the renormalization group (RG) flows connecting them. While these are well understood at weak coupling, a complete strong-coupling picture remains an open problem. In this paper, we present a systematic strong-coupling analysis of the fixed points and operator spectrum underlying defect RG flows in ABJM, via holography.
